name: Tiétar (Spain)
description: Green field with a white and blue wavy band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tiétar (ears of wheat and a leaf on green and white).
history: Municipal flag of Tiétar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy band with blue lines from the lower hoist to the upper fly, the river Tiétar
Tiétar arms — ears of wheat and leaf
